en.headline: Cardboard airport exhibition Runway 51 closes this weekend
en.dek: American artist Barminski’s full-scale cardboard airport installation at JPS Gallery in Central ends on 19 September, inviting visitors into a playful alien-transit fantasy.
body: The exhibition Runway 51 by American artist Barminski at JPS Gallery in Central is scheduled to close on 19 September after a summer run that turned the gallery into a life-sized cardboard airport.

Visitors walk through a security checkpoint staffed by an alien figure, past terminal restrooms and customs desks constructed entirely from cardboard with hand-drawn details and bold colour. The work continues the artist’s exploration of everyday spaces as sites of hidden or fantastical activity, following an earlier cardboard toy-shop installation that concealed an Area 51 narrative.

JPS Gallery is located on the ground floor of 88-90 Staunton Street in Central. The show has been free to enter during regular gallery hours. Organisers have not announced an extension beyond the listed closing date.

zh.headline: 紙板機場裝置展「Runway 51」本周末結束
zh.dek: 美國藝術家 Barminski 於中環 JPS Gallery 打造的全尺寸紙板機場裝置將於9月19日閉幕，讓觀眾走進一個充滿外星過境幻想的空間。
body: 美國藝術家 Barminski 在中環 JPS Gallery 舉行的「Runway 51」展覽，將於9月19日結束。展覽以全紙板搭建出一座等比例機場，包括安檢通道、洗手間及海關櫃位。
觀眾會經過一名外星工作人員把守的安檢點，紙板結構配上手繪線條與鮮明色彩。作品延續藝術家以日常空間隱藏奇幻敘事的風格，早前亦曾以紙板玩具店裝置隱藏 Area 51 故事。
畫廊位於中環士丹頓街88-90號地下，展覽期間免費入場。主辦方暫未公布延長展期安排。
